content.text:
On a cache `get`, `Segment.recordRead(entry, now)` runs lock-free and simply does `recencyQueue.add(entry)` (a `ConcurrentLinkedQueue<ReferenceEntry<K,V>>`). The lock-guarded `Segment.drainRecencyQueue()` (called while the segment lock is held, e.g. during a later write or eviction) later polls that queue and moves each entry to the back of the LRU access list.

ANSWER: On read, `Segment.recordRead(entry, now)` is called without the segment lock and appends the entry to the lock-free `recencyQueue` (a `ConcurrentLinkedQueue<ReferenceEntry<K,V>>`); the `@GuardedBy("this")` method `Segment.drainRecencyQueue()`, run later while the segment lock is held, drains that queue and reorders the LRU access list accordingly.
